parent_v2_3.key_result: In one 7x3 orthogonally activated system, BAM-state uniqueness was 0% at E0, 32.8125% at E4 and 100% at E5; targeted direct-A+B required <=3 nodes and direct-M accessibility <=2 nodes.
parent_v2_3.rule: v2.3 is immutable; v3 tests whether those local bounds generalize.

finite_system_roster.environment_generator: 2-D gradient + row structure + deterministic seeded local heterogeneity
finite_system_roster.barrier_policy: closed systems have no gap; gap systems have one middle-row gap

BAM_generation.A: Two source-containing focal abiotic niche breadths generated from the focal source environment.
BAM_generation.B: Four interaction modes from independently generated partner and antagonist virtual species, each with its own A∩M state.
BAM_generation.M: 2 dispersal radii × 2 barrier-permeability states × 2 finite horizons.
BAM_generation.state_identity: A set + B set + M set + complete first-arrival vector

per_system: at least one A-only positive witness pair
at least one B-only positive witness pair
at least one M-only positive witness pair
at least one exact-G equivalence pair
at least one positive-superset / diagnostic-negative pair
pre_scoring_activation_gate.terminal_rule: A system failing any gate is DESIGN_STOP and remains in the denominator. No parameter repair or replacement.

evidence_ladder: E1 E0 + complete perfect surveyed negatives
E2 E1 + exact arrival time on truth-positive nodes
E3 E2 + complete direct A state
E4 E3 + complete direct B state
E5 E4 + complete direct M accessibility
E6 E5 + complete direct M first-arrival state

preregistered_generality_claims.claim: The v2.3 result that positive occurrences alone uniquely identify 0% of BAM truths generalizes to every scored v3 system.
preregistered_generality_claims.decision_rule: SUPPORTED only if every scored system has BAM-state unique fraction E0=0. Any truth uniquely identified at E0 REFUTES this universal bound.

preregistered_generality_claims.claim: The v2.3 pattern E4<1 and E5=1 generalizes to every scored system: direct M accessibility is always the final missing evidence required for BAM-state recovery.
preregistered_generality_claims.decision_rule: SUPPORTED only if every scored system has E4<1 and E5=1. Any system violating either condition REFUTES the universal claim.

preregistered_generality_claims.claim: The v2.3 targeted direct-A+B bound of at most 3 nodes generalizes to every eligible truth in every scored v3 system.
preregistered_generality_claims.decision_rule: SUPPORTED only if max targeted A+B node count <=3 across the full scored denominator; one truth requiring >3 refutes G3.

preregistered_generality_claims.claim: The v2.3 targeted direct-M accessibility bound of at most 2 nodes generalizes to every eligible truth in every scored v3 system.
preregistered_generality_claims.decision_rule: SUPPORTED only if max targeted M-accessibility node count <=2; one truth requiring >2 refutes G4.

preregistered_generality_claims.claim: After complete A, B, M accessibility and full M arrival evidence (E6), every scored truth collapses to its exact BAM-state equivalence class.
preregistered_generality_claims.decision_rule: Any non-equivalent BAM state surviving E6 refutes G5.

preregistered_generality_claims.claim: BAM-state identification fraction is non-decreasing from E0 through E6 in every scored system.

primary_outputs: per-system and pooled exact-G equivalence distributions
forbidden_after_results: drop a scored system that refutes a v2.3 bound

language.cpp_rule: No C++ port in v3 unless optimized Python system sweep itself exceeds 60 seconds CI wall-clock. Scientific definitions remain in Python.
